# Quality Improvement Methods (LEAN, PDSA, SIX SIGMA)

**Authors:** Emily Barr, Grace D. Brannan

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

Quality improvement is integral to many sectors, including business, manufacturing, and healthcare. Systematic and structured approaches are used to evaluate performance to improve standards and outcomes. The Institute of Medicine defines quality in healthcare as “the degree to which health services for individuals and populations increase the likelihood of desired health outcomes and are consistent with current professional knowledge.”
